notation: E = routed experts of the layer (read from the counts tensor, 60 for every Qwen1.5-MoE-A2.7B layer: config num_experts=60, num_experts_per_tok=4, decoder_sparse_step=1, 24 layers), k = top-k = 4, c_e(S) routed-token count of expert e in prefix S, n = |S|

std.eq4: sigma_l = sqrt( 1/(E-1) sum_e (u_e - mean u)^2 )  [paper Eq. 4]
std.algorithm1: sigma_l = sqrt( E/(E-1) sum_e (u_e - mean u)^2 )  [Algorithm 1 line 30, transcribed from asserts/Algorithm_1_EBSS.png] = sqrt(E) * eq4

aggregation: sigma = (1/L) sum_l sigma_l over all L = 24 MoE layers (Eq. 3); Algorithm 1 line 30 shows a single sigma without an explicit layer mean -- the layer mean of Eq. 3 is kept for every variant (only the per-layer normalisation varies)
prefix: sigma of the PARENT prefix S (deferred balance, Eq. 13 / Sec. 4.2), unchanged
tau: divides sigma, tau = 1.3 for every variant (never altered to emulate a normalisation)
effective_tau_note: reported for explanation only; the implementation applies the normalisation explicitly with tau = 1.3
